Package com.nexuslink.protocol.servicebus

Class ServiceBusConnectionString

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.servicebus.ServiceBusConnectionString
public final class ServiceBusConnectionString extends Object
Pure, dependency-free parser for an Azure Service Bus connection string. Like the Storage strings, these are a sequence of Key=Value; pairs with case-insensitive keys, e.g. 
Endpoint=sb://ns.servicebus.windows.net/;SharedAccessKeyName=RootManageSharedAccessKey;SharedAccessKey=abc==

The value inside SharedAccessKey may itself contain = padding, so pairs are split on the first = only. This does no network I/O and pulls in no SDK; it exposes the recognised fields plus the derived namespace host. It also recognises the UseDevelopmentEmulator=true flag used by the local Service Bus emulator, whose endpoint is a plain sb://localhost rather than a *.servicebus.windows.net host.
